label: Executable research baselines generated from current model outputs; NOT clinical targets, diagnostic thresholds, or fitted patient data.
scientific_status: research demonstration baseline; not clinically validated
change_policy: Fixture changes require a reviewed change record explaining the mechanism, evidence, and expected direction (validation_registry.yaml VAL-REGRESSION).

change_records.change: Initial executable research baseline generated from model version 0.1.0 outputs.

Hyperadrenergic chronotropic gain 100.0 to 103.0; ME/CFS delayed-stress, PEM-onset, and PEM-recovery constants set to 43200, 172800, and 86400 s. Regenerated only the two affected runs after the original values failed declared phenotype criteria.
change_records.mechanism: MEC-AUT-HYPERADRENERGIC and MEC-RCV-PEM; assumption-only calibration, no new empirical claim
change_records.evidence: VAL-POTS-HYPER and VAL-ME-PEM; CLM-POTS-CRITERIA and CLM-ME-PEM-KINETICS
change_records.expected_direction: Hyperadrenergic orthostatic HR rise increases from 29.33 to 30.16 bpm; early PEM decreases below 0.01 while delayed peak, recovery, and next-day capacity reduction remain observable. These are scenario corrections, not clinical targets.

change_records.change: Stage 1 shared-physiology remediation: four-volume regional architecture; separate cardiac-sympathetic, vascular-sympathetic and vagal states; head-level baroreflex and cerebral perfusion; independent rhythmic and sustained muscle inputs; per-phenotype supine fixed-point calibration; sustained POTS/Long-COVID chronotropic calibration; PEM onset/recovery correction with 20 h delayed stress and seven-day follow-up. Added four muscle-protocol regression runs. Stage 0 fixture and fresh baseline log remain preserved under validation/baseline/stage0/.
change_records.mechanism: MEC-CV-VOLUME, MEC-AUT-BAROREFLEX, MEC-VASC-POOLING, MEC-VASC-CONSTRICTION, MEC-CBF-AUTOREG and MEC-RCV-PEM; reviewed scientific architecture and scenario calibrations, not new empirical claims
change_records.evidence: docs/stage1/literature-and-evidence-matrix.md; docs/stage1/revised-physiological-architecture.md design-review record; VAL-MATH-EQUILIBRIUM, VAL-PHYS-SHARED, VAL-POTS-NEUROPATHIC, VAL-POTS-HYPER, VAL-POTS-HYPO, VAL-POTS-MIXED and VAL-ME-PEM
change_records.expected_direction: Regional pooling and CPP-based cerebral responses replace aggregated peripheral behavior; all configured supine residuals approach zero. Sustained POTS and Long-COVID autonomic HR rises meet or exceed 30 bpm without restoring hypovolemic resting CO to healthy. Early PEM remains below 0.01 and prolonged recovery becomes observable within the extended protocol. Numerical metric changes are expected and recorded rather than treated as silent regressions.
change_records.review: Independent design review incorporated in docs/stage1/revised-physiological-architecture.md; final seven-layer validation recorded under validation/reports/.

change_records.change: Stage 1.1 explicit-angle posture, separate aortic/carotid/brain pressures, bounded segment-specific CO2 regulation, and one aggregated residual systemic venous compartment. Regenerated all existing runs without changing disease-specific PEM mechanisms, chronotropic gains, acceptance thresholds, or tolerance classes.
change_records.mechanism: MEC-CV-VOLUME, MEC-AUT-BAROREFLEX, MEC-CBF-AUTOREG, MEC-CBF-CO2 and MEC-VASC-POOLING; reviewed structural change, not pass-driven calibration
change_records.expected_direction: Supine fixed points and total stressed-volume conservation are retained. At 70 degrees, healthy and POTS sustained HR rises decrease relative to Stage 1; the resulting POTS threshold failures are preserved as strict expected failures and scientific-matrix FAIL records. No parameter was adjusted to reproduce a predetermined CO, SV, HR, or CFI result.
change_records.review: Stage 1.1 design and negative-results review recorded under docs/stage1-1/ and validation/stage1-1/.

change_records.change: Stage 1.2 orthostatic remediation: effective dependent heights are calibrated for all three peripheral venous beds, POTS caudal heights are increased without changing chronotropic gains, and the cerebral autoregulation residual slope is calibrated within its existing range. Regenerated affected orthostatic runs; tolerance classes and scientific criteria are unchanged.
change_records.mechanism: MEC-CV-VOLUME, MEC-VASC-POOLING, MEC-AUT-BAROREFLEX and MEC-CBF-AUTOREG; geometry and autoregulation calibration, not a new empirical claim
change_records.evidence: CLM-ORTHO-HYDROSTATIC; CLM-CV-VENOUS-RETURN; REF-ZAIDI-2000; VAL-POTS-NEUROPATHIC; VAL-POTS-HYPER; VAL-POTS-HYPO; VAL-POTS-MIXED; tests/physiological/test_stage1_2_orthostatic_fidelity.py
change_records.expected_direction: Residual systemic venous volume now accumulates rather than drains during tilt. Healthy early CO and late CO/SV reductions increase into or near their preserved plausibility bands; healthy caudal pooling remains bounded. Sustained POTS and Long-COVID-autonomic HR rises exceed 30 bpm without disabling conservation or the MAP floor. Healthy and ME/CFS end-tilt CFI reductions remain within their declared bands.
change_records.review: Stage 1.2 root-cause analysis, residual limitations and executed validation are recorded under docs/stage1-2/ and validation/stage1-2/.

change_records.change: Stage 1.3 constitutive remediation: redistribute peripheral venous compliances, add one-sided quadratic dependent-venous elastance, use common anatomical hydrostatic geometry across disease phenotypes, revise baroreflex weighting and vascular/cardiac compensation, and reduce the cerebral autoregulation residual slope. Neuropathic-POTS impaired peripheral sympathetic gains are 0.34 and both hEDS configurations use lower-limb compliance 70 mL/mmHg. Regenerated every stored run without changing tolerances or scientific acceptance criteria.
change_records.mechanism: MEC-CV-VOLUME, MEC-VASC-POOLING, MEC-VASC-CONSTRICTION, MEC-AUT-BAROREFLEX and MEC-CBF-AUTOREG; exploratory structural and parameter assumptions, not measured patient properties
change_records.expected_direction: The nonlinear term limits dependent-bed overfilling while preserving five-volume conservation and the twelve-state architecture. Relative to Stage 1.2, healthy caudal pooling increases, residual-systemic volume drains slightly rather than accumulates excessively, end-tilt MAP over-defense decreases, and 60-degree CO/SV reductions enter their preserved direct experimental-angle comparison bands. Phenotype numerical outputs change because common anatomy replaces phenotype-specific heights; no threshold was widened.
change_records.review: Mechanisms were executed independently before combination. The audit linear proposal failed the preserved orthostatic comparisons and was not adopted; see validation/stage1-3/scientific-comparison-matrix.md and docs/stage1-3/implementation-and-validation.md.
